name: PO vs SO details
query:
SELECT 
    po.name AS "Purchase Order:Link/Purchase Order:150",
    po.supplier AS "Supplier:Link/Supplier:150",
    poi.item_code AS "Item Code:Link/Item:120",
    poi.qty AS "PO Ordered Qty:Float:100",
    poi.received_qty AS "PO Received Qty:Float:100",
    (poi.qty - poi.received_qty) AS "PO Pending Qty:Float:100",
    poi.schedule_date AS "PO Delivery Date:Date:120",
    
    so.name AS "Sales Order:Link/Sales Order:150",
    so.customer AS "Customer:Link/Customer:150",
    soi.item_code AS "SO Item Code:Link/Item:120",
    soi.qty AS "SO Ordered Qty:Float:100",
    soi.delivered_qty AS "SO Delivered Qty:Float:100",
    (soi.qty - soi.delivered_qty) AS "SO Pending Qty:Float:100",
    soi.delivery_date AS "SO Expected Delivery:Date:120",

    po.status AS "PO Status::100",
    so.status AS "SO Status::100"
FROM 
    `tabPurchase Order Item` poi
LEFT JOIN 
    `tabPurchase Order` po ON poi.parent = po.name
LEFT JOIN 
    `tabSales Order Item` soi ON poi.item_code = soi.item_code
LEFT JOIN 
    `tabSales Order` so ON soi.parent = so.name
WHERE 
    po.status NOT IN ('Completed', 'Cancelled')
    AND so.status NOT IN ('Completed', 'Cancelled')
ORDER BY 
    poi.schedule_date DESC, soi.delivery_date DESC;
